title: Vulnerability discovered in outdated Solana contracts
description: Rain said its monitoring systems discovered a vulnerability affecting a small number of programs using an outdated version of its Solana contracts; other programs were not impacted.

title: Outdated Solana contract programs upgraded
description: Rain said all programs using the outdated Solana contract version were successfully upgraded and that the immediate situation was resolved.

title: Rain announces affected users will be made whole
description: Rain announced that all affected users would be made whole and that remediation had begun.

title: Third-party forensic investigation announced
description: Rain said it engaged third-party forensic experts and would work with law enforcement and relevant regulatory authorities.

title: Avici card balances affected by unauthorized withdrawals
description: Avici said the affected assets were in a separate Solana card-balance contract rather than users' self-custodial wallets. Its reconciliation reported 1,685 affected users and $500,859.22 in affected card balances.

title: Avici announces full card-balance reimbursement
description: Avici said every affected user's card balance would be refunded in full.

title: Tria reports unauthorized withdrawals from Solana card balances
description: Tria reported unauthorized withdrawal reports involving Solana USDC/USDT topped up to card balances.

title: KAST confirms it was not affected
description: KAST publicly stated that it was aware of the situation affecting other card providers and that KAST was not affected.

title: Tria says issue resolved and affected users will be made whole
description: Tria stated that the issue affecting Solana card balances had been resolved and that all affected users would be made whole. This is not evidence that reimbursement had already completed.

title: Solayer Pay confirms it was not affected
description: Solayer Pay stated that it was not affected and that its funds were secure and operational.

title: MetaMask Metal Card orders temporarily paused
description: MetaMask documentation states that orders for the Metal Card were temporarily paused as of June 2, 2026, while existing eligible card usage remained available according to the applicable regional terms.

title: MiniPay launches its Visa debit card
description: Gnosis Pay announced the launch of the MiniPay Card as a digital Visa debit card inside Opera's MiniPay wallet, powered by Gnosis Pay and issued through Monavate.

title: Nexo Card launches in select European markets
description: Nexo officially launched the Nexo Card in select European markets with DiPocket as card issuer and Mastercard as payment network.

title: Nexo Card gains Dual Mode
description: Nexo introduced switchable debit and credit modes for the Nexo Card, materially changing how cardholders could fund spending.

title: BitPay documents new card applications as temporarily paused
description: By October 27, 2023, BitPay publicly documented that new BitPay Card applications were temporarily paused while it improved the crypto debit card program; the statement did not say the card program had permanently shut down.

title: Legacy EEA/CH Bybit.com Card reaches transition deadline
description: Bybit directed EEA residents using the legacy Bybit.com card programme to apply for the separate Bybit EU Card and recommended completing the transition no later than December 31, 2025 to avoid interruption. This records the regional transition requirement, not proof that every holder completed migration.

title: Gemini Credit Card launches to eligible U.S. applicants
description: Gemini announced the Gemini Credit Card as available to eligible individuals across all 50 U.S. states, with WebBank as issuing bank and Mastercard as the exclusive network partner.

title: CL Card expands to the United States
description: Ledger announced expansion of the CL Card to the United States and identified the U.S. product as a Visa crypto card powered by Baanx.

title: U.S. Crypto.com prepaid card issuer structure documented as changed by 2025 agreement
description: A historical U.S. cardholder agreement effective in 2021 identified Metropolitan Commercial Bank as issuer, while the U.S. agreement effective September 2, 2025 identifies Community Federal Savings Bank. The reviewed documents establish that the issuer structure changed by the 2025 agreement effective date but do not establish the exact operational cutover day.

title: Wirex documents end of Contis partnership and legacy Visa-card context
description: Wirex UK terms state that its partnership with Contis Financial Services ended on March 16, 2021 and direct holders with funds remaining on the old single-currency Visa Card to contact Contis. The source establishes the partnership end and legacy-card context but does not identify a replacement provider in the same statement.

title: Bitpanda replaces old card and changes issuer to TPML
description: Bitpanda states that its old card was deactivated on March 31, 2025 and the new card could be activated from April 1, 2025. Historical terms identify UAB Finansinės paslaugos „Contis“ as issuer of the old Visa card, while the replacement-card terms dated April 1 identify Transact Payments Malta Limited as issuer.

title: U.S. Uphold card infrastructure documented as changed by 2025 agreement
description: The current Uphold Visa Card agreement last updated September 16, 2025 identifies Cross River Bank as issuer and Visa as network, while an archived U.S. agreement identifies Metropolitan Commercial Bank and Mastercard. This records an evidence milestone showing the infrastructure had changed by the current agreement date; it does not assert that the operational cutover occurred on September 16.

title: Binance confirms European Visa debit-card program will close
description: Contemporaneous reporting reproducing the customer notice and quoting a Binance spokesperson states that the Binance Visa Debit Card would no longer be available from December 20, 2023. This event records the closure announcement; the original historical Binance support page was not retrievable during this review.

title: European Binance Visa Debit Card program reaches closure date
description: The Binance closure notice stated that affected users would no longer be able to use the Binance Visa Debit Card from December 20, 2023 and that the Contis-issued program was closing.

title: BlockFi Rewards Visa becomes inactive after Visa termination letter
description: A BlockFi bankruptcy court filing states that Visa sent BlockFi a letter on November 16, 2022 purporting to terminate the parties' relationship and that the BlockFi Rewards Visa was no longer active. Outstanding credit-card obligations continued to be serviced separately through Deserve.

title: Coinbase Card launches in the United Kingdom
description: Coinbase launched a Visa debit card in the United Kingdom that let customers spend supported crypto balances from their Coinbase accounts; the launch announcement identified Paysafe Financial Services Limited as issuer.

title: Bank of Lithuania revokes UAB PAYRNET EMI licence
description: The Bank of Lithuania revoked UAB PAYRNET's electronic-money-institution licence for serious, systematic and multiple violations and stated that the company could no longer provide financial services.

title: Cryptopay warns EU cardholders after PayrNet licence revocation
description: Reporting on Cryptopay's customer email said UAB PayrNet provided its EU debit-card service and that customers were urged to spend or transfer card funds promptly because card service could stop. Cryptopay account balances outside the card were described separately as unaffected.

title: Cryptopay terms document DiPocket-issued card generation
description: Cryptopay card terms dated March 17, 2025 identify DiPocket UAB as issuer, CPS Europe S.A. as programme manager and Visa as the card scheme. The document date is treated as an evidence milestone, not an asserted operational cutover date.

title: WaveCrest-issued TenX cards stop working outside Europe
description: TenX said WaveCrest would no longer issue or maintain Visa prepaid cards outside the European territory and that affected active TenX cards would no longer be usable from October 16, 2017; European-issued WaveCrest cards remained usable at that stage.

title: Remaining WaveCrest-issued TenX cards become unusable
description: TenX reported that WaveCrest disabled its cards after an urgent card-network advisory, leaving the reviewed WaveCrest-issued TenX generation unable to transact. TenX said it was working on replacement cards with a new issuer.

title: Bitwala halts WaveCrest card offering
description: Bitwala's retrospective states that Visa abruptly terminated its relationship with WaveCrest in 2018 and that Bitwala was forced to halt its debit-card offering. This event applies to the reviewed WaveCrest card generation rather than later Bitwala/Nuri products.

title: European WaveCrest-issued BitPay Card closes
description: Contemporaneous reporting reproducing BitPay's statement says the European BitPay Card was no longer available from issuer Wave Crest Holdings Ltd after the January 2018 shutdown, while U.S. BitPay Card users were unaffected.
